description: Did this employer's board serve more roles than 7 days earlier? One row per companyToken (up to 20 a call), judged by the board from our own daily observation and passed through untouched: grew, no-growth, or unknown, and unknown ALWAYS carries unknown_reason (a reading we could not take, never a no). The bars: at least 10 roles served at the start; then BOTH 4 more roles AND 25% more, on a board tracked for at least 21 days, every read in the window whole. Per board, never summed; not a headcount and not a hire. This tool never ranks employers, and no list of growing employers exists here or anywhere on the board.

companyTokens.description: companyToken values from job cards or search_jobs. Up to 20; more is refused with the count named.

name: employer_growth
title: Did this employer's board grow?
